race.comment: POBLANO (7) has gone under her past couple in narrow fashion in this grade when jumping the favourite. She still has plenty of upside and maps to get every chance again today back to 1200m. Pike sticks and she can go one better this time around. HURRICANE HARLEY (3) won by 0.7L at this track and trip 70 days ago before a short break. That form has worked out well and he lands here without been sighted publicly since. Can land up front again and he can repeat the dose. MILITARY POWER (1) should be better suited coming out in trip after flying late over the short course his past couple. He bumped into a handy type last start and if he can run up to his recent efforts, he'll be right in the finish once again. CHAMPAGNE CRUSADER (4) is third-up now and comes back to an easier grade. Expecting an improved run. LUCKY I AM (6) can improve third-up.
